yang2024sweagent.title_norm: swe agent agent computer interfaces enable automated software engineering
yang2024sweagent.claim_summary: Introduces SWE-agent and demonstrates that specially designed Agent-Computer Interfaces (ACIs) substantially improve coding-agent performance.

starace2025paperbench.title_norm: paperbench evaluating ai s ability to replicate ai research
starace2025paperbench.claim_summary: Introduces PaperBench (20 ICML 2024 Spotlight/Oral papers, 8,316 rubric tasks), where the strongest autonomous agent reaches an average replication score of 21.0%.

greshake2023indirect.title_norm: not what you ve signed up for compromising real world llm integrated applications with indirect prompt injection
greshake2023indirect.claim_summary: Introduces Indirect Prompt Injection, showing adversarial prompts hidden in external retrieved content can hijack LLM-integrated applications.

lu2024aiscientist.title_norm: the ai scientist towards fully automated open ended scientific discovery
lu2024aiscientist.claim_summary: Introduces The AI Scientist, an automated end-to-end LLM framework performing idea generation, experimentation, paper writing, and automated reviewing.

schmotz2026skillinject.title_norm: skill inject measuring agent vulnerability to skill file attacks
schmotz2026skillinject.claim_summary: Evaluates 202 injection-task pairs spanning obvious to subtle context-dependent skill-file attacks, observing up to 80% ASR on frontier LLMs and showing model scaling and naive input filters are insufficient.

xu2026agentskills.title_norm: agent skills for large language models architecture acquisition security and the path forward
xu2026agentskills.claim_summary: Surveys Agent Skills architecture, acquisition, security, and progressive disclosure, citing empirical analyses finding 26.1% of community-contributed skills contain vulnerabilities.

yamada2025aiscientistv2.title_norm: the ai scientist v2 workshop level automated scientific discovery via agentic tree search
yamada2025aiscientistv2.claim_summary: Introduces The AI Scientist-v2 using agentic tree search to autonomously execute experiments, analyze data, and author a peer-review-accepted workshop paper.

wang2026skilltester.title_norm: skilltester benchmarking utility and security of agent skills
wang2026skilltester.claim_summary: Presents SkillTester, a quality-assurance harness pairing baseline vs. with-skill execution with a security probe suite to produce normalized utility and security scores.

song2026paperorchestra.title_norm: paperorchestra a multi agent framework for automated ai research paper writing
song2026paperorchestra.claim_summary: Proposes PaperOrchestra, a multi-agent framework transforming unstructured pre-writing materials into LaTeX manuscripts and visuals, achieving 50%-68% literature review and 14%-38% overall win margins on 200-paper PaperWritingBench.

zhang2026reusable.title_norm: what keeps agent skills from being reusable evidence from 138k skill md files
zhang2026reusable.claim_summary: Audits 138,133 public SKILL.md files across 20,556 repositories, finding 91.8% contain >=1 defect and showing spec-compliant metadata improves 20K-skill startup routing.

li2026skillsbench.title_norm: skillsbench benchmarking how well agent skills work across diverse tasks
li2026skillsbench.claim_summary: Evaluates 87 tasks across 8 domains and 18 model-harness pairs; curated skills lift pass rates from 33.9% to 50.5% (+16.6 pp), and focused skills (<=3 modules) outperform larger exhaustive bundles.

liang2024feedback.title_norm: can large language models provide useful feedback on research papers a large scale empirical analysis
liang2024feedback.claim_summary: Empirical study of 3,096 Nature-family and 1,709 ICLR papers plus 308 researchers showing LLM review overlap with humans (30.85% Nature, 39.23% ICLR) matches inter-human overlap (28.58%/35.25%), with 57.4% rating feedback helpful.

weng2024cycleresearcher.title_norm: cycleresearcher improving automated research via automated review
weng2024cycleresearcher.claim_summary: Trains open-source LLMs (CycleResearcher/CycleReviewer) to iteratively perform automated research and simulated peer review.

huang2024selfcorrect.title_norm: large language models cannot self correct reasoning yet
huang2024selfcorrect.claim_summary: Demonstrates that LLMs cannot reliably self-correct reasoning without external feedback and can degrade initially correct answers.

destefanis2026gitskills.title_norm: gitskills a dataset of agent skills on github
destefanis2026gitskills.claim_summary: Mines 3,797,117 public SKILL.md files (1,877,981 unique contents) across 282,200 GitHub repositories and notes that natural-language skills lack compilers, type checkers, or package verifiers.

zhu2026paperbanana.title_norm: paperbanana automating academic illustration for ai scientists
zhu2026paperbanana.claim_summary: Introduces PaperBanana, a VLM and image-generation agentic framework automating academic illustration generation and iterative visual refinement.

lv2026structuredaudit.title_norm: structured security auditing and robustness enhancement for untrusted agent skills
lv2026structuredaudit.claim_summary: Proposes SkillGuard-Robust for structured cross-file security auditing of untrusted Agent Skill bundles under semantics-preserving rewrites.

saha2026underhood.title_norm: under the hood of skill md semantic supply chain attacks on ai agent skill registry
saha2026underhood.claim_summary: Demonstrates SKILL.md-only semantic supply-chain attacks on public skill registries achieving up to 86% retrieval win rate, 77.6% paired-trial selection rate, and 36.5%-100% governance evasion.

badhe2026skillsecurity.title_norm: agent skill security threat models attacks defenses and evaluation
badhe2026skillsecurity.claim_summary: Introduces SkillSec-Eval and evaluates 327 real-world skills across a five-stage lifecycle (repository admission, semantic retrieval, planner selection, execution, and skill evolution).

google2026egm.title_norm: elephant goldfish model egm multi harness spec driven development and fresh context review plugin
google2026egm.claim_summary: Open-source multi-harness plugin (v0.1.1) spanning Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex with fresh-context Goldfish review personas and a nested synthesizer agent for engineering design documents.
